scientific_definition.eligibility: finite strictly-positive valid adjacent detected-bout frames; no-bout/invalid excluded before log
scientific_definition.bin_estimator: median of eligible original log frames
scientific_definition.baseline_estimator: median of finite baseline-bin medians; each bin one vote
scientific_definition.missing: NaN black; entire trial missing if insufficient or collapsed baseline
scientific_definition.timing: Uses authenticated existing cadence-reconstructed time_s; not a new measured-AbsoluteTime reconstruction. Movement masks retain their original detection recipe; no analytical smoothing added.
